thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High restart rate on gpu-pool-4 -> containers restarting during prefill (OOM). 37 restarts in last 5m. affected model: open-llama-70B-quant. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-oom
oncall-jamie: oncall here, ack. paging SRE. any immediate customer impact?
sre-alyssa: seeing lots of CUDA OOMs and oom_kill in kube events on nodes gpu-4b12..15. logs show prefill allocation failures:
```
[ERR] prefill: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
Container restart reason: oom_kill
kv_cache_alloc requested=1.2GB available=0.8GB
```
eng-raj: confirmed. traces show a few very long context requests (single tenant) hitting >600k tokens in prefill, causing kvcache blowup.
support-tanya: CS reports two customers with partial/garbled responses and session disconnects since 10:23 UTC. raising incident banner to affected accounts.
oncall-jamie: mitigation plan: throttle long prefill, reduce max_prefill_tokens on gpu-pool-4 to 16384. applying now.
infra-lee: applying config and doing staggered rollout to avoid cascading restarts:
```
redwoodctl set-config --pool gpu-pool-4 --max_prefill_tokens=16384
kubectl rollout restart deployment/serving-runtime -n gpu-pool-4 --strategy=rolling
```
sre-alyssa: also enabling prefill_evict=true for long jobs in that pool to evict very large prefill attempts instead of letting them allocate and kill the container. rolling patch started.
eng-raj: routing fallback enabled for >512k token requests -> open-llama-7B-quant (lower memory variant). also adding per-tenant large-context rate limit temporary rule.
product-oliver: we need a short customer-facing statement. @support-tanya can you collate affected customers + windows and draft message?
support-tanya: on it. current list: acme-analytics, betachat. impact window 10:23-10:45 UTC for those two. CS has opened SE tickets.
cust-ops-maria: drafting: "We experienced transient degradation for very large context requests. Short-term mitigations (prefill throttling, model fallback) applied; no data loss. Investigating root cause and next steps." Will add ETA once we validate.
oncall-jamie: monitoring: error count dropped 37 -> 2 in last 5m, GPU mem pressure decreasing. keeping page open for 30m to verify.
sre-alyssa: starting container heaptrace on a restarted pod for deeper analysis. early kvcache dumps show average large-prefill footprint ~1.1GB. suspicious noisy neighbor (one tenant sending burst of huge prompts). creating incident ticket.
eng-raj: long-term follow-ups: 1) enforce per-tenant large-prefill rate limits 2) improve kvcache allocation checks to fail-fast and fall back to streaming/partial prefill 3) consider autoscale/burst policy for pools with large-context workloads 4) bug: kvcache allocation race when fallback triggers.
oncall-jamie: leaving handoff notes for night oncall (@oncall-maya): config change applied, rollouts stable, customers notified, incident INC-2026-0453 created. check metrics for any restart regressions. will post final update at 11:05 UTC before handoff.
incident-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-0453. Pager duty: notified oncall-maya.
oncall-jamie: thanks all, marking this thread as live-mitigation. will update post-handoff. :thumbsup:
